notes: Whole surviving Arlington House mansion/Q675702 at321ShermanDrive, central two-story block plus connected north/south one-story wings, original15vertexnamedbody and6vertexseparately mapped intrinsic east portico way1500304896. East deep temple portico with six massive smooth Doric front columns and two return columns, broad triangular pediment/pale scored stucco entablature, recessed closed front entries/upper sash and own low steps; pale faux-sandstone stucco body, tall recessed round-headed wing lights, slate central pitched roof and low gravel wing roofs, original native west wall offsets and pale chimneys. Exclude detached slavequarters/bookstore/buildings, LEnfantgrave/foregroundmonument/cemetery/tombs, forecourt/paths/landscape and all interiors/visitors/signage.
